title: TNTGun
description: This project has a tnt gun which allows you to shoot tnt from a custom gun, and also a custom item 'nitro candy', which you can eat to get Speed and you get launched in the air while you have the effect with no fall damage.
body:
## The TNT Gun Mod offers three high-quality items.

### The TNT Launcher
**Behavior**: Fires a Custom TNT Entity, which has a longer range and travels faster than an ordinary block of TNT.
**Impact**: Upon impact, it will blow up like ordinary TNT.
Find it in: The **Combat** tab.

### Nitro Candy 
**The Surge**: When consumed, you gain Speed V and leave a trail of fire behind you.
**The Blast Jump**: When you sprint slam into a wall with this effect, you will trigger a Kinetic Blast explosion at your feet.
**Mace Logic**: You will be launched into the air from the wall you just slams into, with 100% **Fall Damage Protection**. You will always safely land, making this feature the ultimate movement tool.
Find it in: The **Food & Drink** tab.

### The Gravity Anchor
**Vacuum** (Passive): When in your Off-hand, this tool will create a magnetic pull toward you, sucking all items toward you.
**Temporal Freeze** (Active): When you right-click this tool, all items within range will be put into a 5-second Gravity Freeze, causing all items to float in mid-air.
Find it in: The **Combat** tab.
